speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned a rash on your scalp and forehead; can you tell me how long you have had these symptoms and if they are itchy or painful?

speaker: Patient
text: 3-month-old boy. The parents report that the rash has been present for several weeks, noting that it sometimes appears red and scaly, especially during cold weather. The patient was born at 36 weeks' gestation and has been generally healthy since. The patient's father has a history of psoriasis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Psoriasis (specifically scalp and facial involvement in an infant, potentially related to the paternal history, though seborrheic dermatitis or atopic dermatitis are also strong differential diagnoses to confirm with physical exam or trial of treatment).
